findings: Unfiltered descending ledger pages changed from SeekingScan over referralStaffId/effectiveAt plus MajorSort to ordered SequentialScan over effectiveAt DESC and document ID DESC without MajorSort.
Branch ledger and student/trainer history already select dedicated indexes; no duplicate indexes were added for them.
Ascending business-report scans now use the date index but retain MajorSort. A second direction index was not added without runtime/read-versus-write evidence.
limitations: Planner evidence does not measure billed units, latency, savings percentage or currency.
Synthetic equality values can differ from a real parameter-specific plan; recheck representative scopes before workload-wide claims.
The new index adds storage and index write maintenance. Retain it only if measured read benefit justifies that overhead.
